properties.NAME: NATCHITOCHES
properties.CHANGE: NATCHITOCHES Parish created within Natchitoches County. The creation of parishes did not abolish the 12 counties established on 10 Apr 1805. Counties existed for taxing and electoral purposes, while parishes took over jurisdiction of judicial matters.
properties.CITATION: (Orleans Terr. Acts 1807, 1st. Leg., 2nd sess., ch. 1, sec. 9/ p. 12; Calhoun, 85-93)
